name: W36 Morning Flow — Low-Lunge Rotation, Spiderman Plank, Plié Pulses and Happy Baby
description:
The daily 15-minute opener. **The primer swaps thread-the-needle and puppy pose for the low-lunge rotation and down-dog knee-to-head.** **The work block swaps the inchworm and the glute bridge for the spiderman plank and wide plié pulses**, with the push-up greasing set and the dead-bug staying.

**The stretches swap the couch stretch for happy baby,** and the straddle reaches stay. Scorpion, lizard, cossack and pigeon stay.

**Use the readiness screen, not the calendar.** If cossacks and lizard feel open, run the whole thing. If they feel sticky, keep the anchors and drop one work-block move. Five honest minutes still counts.

sets.name: ☀️ Through the Day — Small and Often (Not Now)
sets.notes: Not part of the morning sequence — these are the reminders that get sprinkled through the day.

exercises.notes: Once an hour if you can. Heels down, easy breathing, a little deeper each time.
30s each foot. Let the **ankle** do the correcting, not the hip. Fingertip on a wall is fine on no sleep.
Heel glued down, knee over the toes.
Sole turns **outward** against the band, shin still. The left one is the point.

sets.name: Primer — Low-Lunge Rotation, Down-Dog Knee-to-Head and Brace (~3 min)
sets.notes: Keep moving between shapes rather than settling into holds. The long holds come at the end, when you are warm.

exercises.notes: Back knee down, hand inside the front foot, then **open the chest to the ceiling** and follow the hand with the eyes. Hip flexor and upper back in one shape.
From down dog, drive one knee toward the nose and round the back, then return long. **Hamstrings and upper back wake up together.**
Tight fists, thumbs tucked, hinged slightly forward. **This is the brace the squat is asking for** — wake it here so it is available later.

sets.name: Work Block — Dead-Bug, Spiderman Plank and Plié Pulses (~5 min)
sets.notes: Activate, do not fatigue. One shoulder-stability move, one anti-extension hold, one barre leg block for variety.

exercises.notes: **The greasing set — one quick set, never to failure.** Elbows ~45°, **pack down not up.** A daily habit, not a training stimulus.
Opposite arm and leg reach away slowly. **The low back stays pressed flat the entire time** — the moment it lifts off the floor, that rep was the last one. Slow beats far.
Plank, one knee drives to the same-side elbow, hips level. **Slow; the hips do not rock.**
Wide stance, toes out, small pulses at the bottom of the plié. **Knees track over the toes**; the legs are warming, not working.

sets.name: Yoga Flow — Hip + Back Arc (~7 min)
sets.notes: Goes last because warm muscle stretches deeper. One continuous arc, not a list of holds.

exercises.notes: 30s each side. Thoracic rotation and hip flexor in one shape.
45s each side. Deep lunge, both hands inside the front foot. Forearms if the hip allows.
**Your readiness screen.** Slow, deep, heel down. Read it as a delta against your own normal — the old ankle sprain means a stiff day here is not a bad-session forecast.
Knees wide, shins vertical, hold the feet or ankles and let the sacrum soften toward the floor. **Rock gently side to side.**
Seated wide straddle — reach to each foot, then centre. **Hinge from the hips, don't round to reach further.**
45s each side. Finish here. Let the hips settle before the day starts.

sets.name: 📍 Day-Specific Add-On — Pick by Today's Training (~3-5 min)
sets.notes: Pick only the block that matches today. Two or three moves, not the whole list.

exercises.notes: **Push day.** 30s each arm, elbow at MID height.
**Push day. Rehab anchor.** Thumbs up, lift from the mid-back — the neck stays out of it.
**Push day. Rehab anchor.** Arms stay straight; only the blades move.
**Pull day. Rehab anchor.** Easy decompression before loaded pulling.
**Pull day. Rehab anchor.** Pack down first — the elbows do not bend.

**Pull day — it worked, so it stays.** One light set before the pull-up bar, then **hold a light DB still at about 90° for 30 seconds.** The hold is the new part: a still, moderate load is the calmest thing you can give an irritable tendon, and it goes in before anything hangs off the elbow.
**Pull or KB day. Rehab anchor.** Elbow pinned to the ribs, light or no weight.
**KB day. Rehab anchor.** Ribs down; only the range that stays smooth.
**Legs day.** Toe to wall, heel glued down, knee over the toes — easy reps before the heels go up on the plates.
**Legs day.** 30s each side for the lateral chain.

tips: Five honest minutes beats a skipped fifteen. Anchors first: cossack, lizard, the push-up set.
Low-lunge rotation: follow the hand with the eyes.
If the cossacks read sticky, keep the flow and drop a work-block move rather than rushing the stretches.
